# BioBlend Compounding Pharmacy

> DHA-licensed compounding pharmacy in Dubai, offering personalized formulations for hormone optimization, dermatology, pediatrics, wellness IV therapy, and pet wellness. The site is available in English and Arabic.

BioBlend is a sterile compounding pharmacy that formulates personalized medicine to match each patient's labs, physician plan, and lifestyle — from bio-identical HRT and dermatology serums to pediatric suspensions and pet reformulations.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Personalized compounding pharmacy in Dubai — hormone, dermatology, pediatric, wellness IV, and pet formulations.
- [About](/about): BioBlend's mission, lab standards, and the pharmacists behind every prescription.
- [Services](/services): Overview of personalized medicine labs and how to start a prescription.
- [Hormone Optimization](/services/hormone): Bio-identical HRT, thyroid, adrenal, and andropause protocols.
- [Dermatology & Anti-Aging](/services/dermatology): Custom serums, pigmentation protocols, peptides, and medical peels.
- [Pediatric Compounding](/services/pediatric): Flavored, alcohol-free, sugar-free, and micro-dosed pediatric suspensions.
- [Your Pet's Wellness Matters](/services/pet-wellness): Pet medication reformulations for palatability, safety, and precise dosing.
- [Wellness & IV Therapy](/services/wellness-iv): NAD+ and glutathione IVs, vitamin drips, longevity peptides, and nutraceuticals.
- [For Physicians](/physicians): Partnership information, referral workflows, and clinical support for healthcare providers.
- [Corporate Wellness](/corporate): Tailored formulary programs for clinics, wellness centers, and executive teams.
- [Insights](/insights): Articles and guidance on compounding, personalized medicine, and wellness.
- [Contact](/contact): Book a consultation, transfer a prescription, visit the lab, and pharmacy contact details.
